review: The only thing worse than 1 episode of this is 4 more years of that g@#$a%%ed orange guy.
I don't know which was worse, these guys yapping at me weekly, or these guys being lazy and stupid and only recording once every 3 weeks.
Well, @#$@! How'd this get in my podcast player?
Any chance you guys can help me find my dog?
These damn commies keep talking about the things that are wrong with CAPITALISM, and I won't abide it. They may as well be from NEW YORK CITY!
Proof that anyone is allowed to start a podcast, but not everyone should.
I used to suffer from imposter syndrome, but then I started listening to this podcast and now I know I'm doing better than at least two people in the world.

First they talked about AI, then they talked about Overcast, then they talked about AI again. I hate both of those things with a passion, and I'm glad they talked about them so I can cry on Reddit with my fellow man-babies!
It's not that they're stupid but well-meaning. It's that they're stupid and don't mind subjecting you to it.
I wonder if these guys know people can hear them. I don't think so. There's no way they'd say some of the stupid things they do if they did.
I didn't have a drinking problem before this podcast, but now I do. I can't get those voices out of my head!
You know how you had Clay Daly on as a guest? You think you could do that again, except without either Scott or Peter? And then maybe make it permanent?
Of all the podcasts in the world, this is one of them!
Sometimes Scott and Peter talk, and other times there's amazing, blissful silence.
This podcast is an outstanding example of why not every idea that pops into your head is a good one.
Just when I think these guys are finally growing on me, I realize that's just a terrible fungus.
Sometimes you need a really good podcast to listen to. Other times you just need background noise. This is background noise.
I was cutting them some slack because they are drinking beer, but then they started drinking coffee sometimes and I realized they just really are that stupid.
I listened to the WHOLE episode, not because of how great it was, but because I was working on my car, my hands were covered in grease, and I couldn't skip ahead to something else. You're welcome.
Your podcast is like the Apple Watch – it's saving lives!

You know that time you won 452 million dollars in the lottery and then lost it all gambling and drinking and paying hitmen for services rendered? Yeah, this podcast is exactly like that except without the part about winning the 452 million dollars.
I went for a run while listening to Friends with Brews and I came home with a dislocated shoulder and two broken knees. And that still wasn't as painful as listening to these two guys.
First they only drank beer, then they only drank coffee, then they drank coffee AND beer, then they drank tea... I don't know what these guys are doing, and neither do they!
reviewer: Pick One And Pick It Now

review: Have you ever had a pony that you loved with all your heart, and then it died, and the only thing that cured your grief was THIS podcast? Yeah, me neither.
My doctor told me to cut back on caffeine and alcohol. I told him I'd do it right after I stopped listening to this podcast. He said that's not what he meant, but he also didn't try to stop me.
I bought a $400 pour-over setup because of an episode of this show. The coffee is fine. The episode was not. I'd like to speak to whoever is in charge of the refund department.
Every episode they describe a beer as having 'notes of chocolate.' Every episode. I have never once tasted chocolate in a beer. I'm starting to think there's something wrong with THEM.
I put this on to help my toddler fall asleep. It worked in about ninety seconds. Unfortunately he now wakes up screaming 'THUMBS UP' at 3 AM and we don't know how to make it stop.
Two guys, a cup of coffee, and a beer walk into a podcast. That's it. That's the whole joke. There's no punchline. There's never a punchline. It's been over a hundred episodes.
My smart speaker started playing this on its own. I never asked for it. I've changed my Wi-Fi password twice. It's still playing. Please, if anyone at the company is reading this, send help.
The best part of every episode is when one of them says 'you should try this one' about a beer that is only sold at one grocery store in Portland and was discontinued in 2019.
